title: Post-apocalyptic education
coverage: opening + one cue-ranked passage + headings; partial inspection

passages.text: Last summer, I wrote about the Homework Apocalypse, the coming reality where AI could complete most
- You can’t ask an AI to detect AI writing (even though people keep trying). When asked if something written by a human was written by an AI, GPT-4 gets it wrong 95% of the time.
